name: professor-student-assessment-skills
description: Draft evidence-cited grading suggestions, moderate decisions, and prepare feedback without auto-approving grades.

interface.shortDescription: Grade with evidence, moderation, and professor control.
interface.longDescription: Four focused skills draft criterion-level grading suggestions, support calibrated batch grading, audit approved decisions, and write student feedback. A shared TypeScript CLI validates DataLayer-compatible evaluations and summarizes only human-approved scores; restricted records stay in memory and grades are never auto-approved or published.
defaultPrompt: Grade this submission against its rubric.
Draft feedback from the approved decisions.
